title: The Volcanic Rift · Breaking the Crystal
dek: Farkur struggles through volcanic heat toward a pulsing crystal while the company fights to keep fallen companions alive. Its destruction gives them moments to escape.

facts.Recorded dates: Source posts · 25 September 2026 · in-world date unresolved
facts.Setting: Volcanic terrain; separate return points on Prima
facts.People: Fenwick; Espera; Scribonia; Djöhandrai; Farkur; Ryvyt

body:
Heat and ash arrive before anyone crosses. A black line widens in the air with the sound of splitting stone, opening onto rock and lava. Fenwick hopes he will be useful; Farkur worries that he is out of practice. They enter with Espera, Scribonia, Djöhandrai and Ryvyt. The encounter will leave some of them dependent on the others’ healing while an obscured crystal keeps drawing their attacks.

Old companions at a new opening

Fenwick has gone a long time without answering a rift. He prepares his magical armor and atlas, nervous enough to hope that other people will come. Seeing familiar faces steadies him. Ryvyt, drawn away from his sketches, is delighted to find him there. A longer conversation will have to wait until they survive the crossing.

Farkur’s preparations are less cheerful. He remembers frightening accounts of earlier battles and wonders what his own time away from such danger has cost him. He comes with helpers and a prayer, wanting to protect the others despite his unease. Djöhandrai is caught on the trail between Gartina’s estate and Pristinia; the heat singes his whiskers before he ventures in.

Espera finds the place hot even by the standard of the desert. Scribonia arrives from the Training Dungeon with considerably more confidence. When Fenwick asks for a plan, Scribonia’s answer is to destroy the enemies and not be afraid. The company has little time to test how far that assurance will carry them.

The crystal behind the flames

A gargantuan creature of flame stands in front of a pulsing crystal. The object rests on a central platform, radiating energy and heat. Reaching it requires passing the defenders while enduring the ground and air around them.

The giant throws a rock between Scribonia and Ryvyt. Fiery fragments scatter into the company. Scribonia’s wings grow and multiply, and the figure fighting there takes on a radiant, many-eyed form. It bears the heat and strikes at an opposing aspect while the others maneuver around dangers they cannot dismiss so readily.

Fenwick summons a crown of stars and fires a mote into the fight. Djöhandrai searches for a position from which he can shoot, struggling to keep track of creatures moving around the lava. The crystal is visible beyond all this activity, but recognizing the likely objective has not made it easy to reach.

Farkur goes around the back

Ryvyt uses a fan to send wind across the field, clearing smoke. Farkur, whose protective aura has proved less helpful than he hoped, moves quickly around the back. He is looking for a route to the crystal while the others occupy its defenders.

Djöhandrai notices the connection between the crystal’s pulse and the heat. He aims at it. One arrow misses; another strikes, but the impact is too slight to finish the work. The crystal flares and renews itself as its light darkens. Reaching it once, or landing one small hit, will not be enough.

The field keeps changing around the company. Two land-shark-like creatures leap into them and knock adventurers prone. Lightning brings smoke and soot back around an obscured enemy. Fenwick works to relieve the pressure on Farkur; Scribonia attacks the rearward enemies with a radiant blade. Farkur spends some of his strength healing companions, then charges the crystal and calls for Ryvyt. His fear has not gone away, but he has committed himself to the target.

Rock, soot and fallen companions

A rock strikes Espera down. Fenwick sees the fall while struggling to maintain his own magic. He insists that no one is going to die there. It is a promise he wants to keep, made while the fight is already showing him how difficult that will be.

Farkur keeps striking the crystal. From his position in the haze he cannot see enough of the others to judge their peril. Ryvyt calls back to him, but the burst of healing he sends lands on Djöhandrai. Elsewhere Espera gets up, still weakened by the heat. Recovery does not make the ground safe.

As Djöhandrai moves away from Espera and Ryvyt, molten rock falls on them. He is about to cry out when he sees Fenwick and Scribonia restoring the two with magic. His relief depends on the work of companions who are themselves running short of strength. Fenwick starts toward the crystal, sees how badly hurt he is, heals Ryvyt and drinks a potion.

The crystal pulses again. To those watching, it appears to repair itself, although the light continues to blacken. Fenwick calls that he has Disintegrate available and suggests it might serve better than hammering at the object. Farkur hears him, but the haze leaves him with no viable option he can see. He continues to hit it.

The dimension begins to tear

The crystal is reduced to dust. Immediately, the dimension begins to tear and the rift closes in on itself. The ending establishes the destruction and the collapse that follows; it does not identify whose last blow or spell completes the work.

The company has obtained the result it needed, but it cannot linger to examine it. Scribonia returns to a familiar form. Fenwick tells the others to leave. Espera heads for the exit on unsteady legs, and Ryvyt jumps out. Plans for conversation belong on the other side.

Fenwick’s departing enemies remain banished under the ruling given for this encounter. Those still inside have their own reason to hurry: the space in which they have been fighting is coming apart. They have kept their companions alive long enough to reach this moment, and now they must use it.

Separate returns

Farkur disengages when he sees the opening close and jumps through. He lands in Pristinia, where he began. Djöhandrai has a more immediate concern than the ruined dimension: he wants to know about the shop Farkur has just invited him to visit. He bounds after him and asks which shop.

The rift does not let him follow Farkur to the same destination. Djöhandrai is sent back to his own stretch of trail between Gartina’s estate and Pristinia. Ryvyt supplies the name Ryvyting Creations in Pristinia, but the conversation has not yet become a visit. Their return divides the company according to where each answered the opening.

As everyone leaves, a heavy creature is heard striking the ground somewhere beyond the closing scene. Its landing place is not shown. The immediate account ends with the rift collapsed and the adventurers out, rather than with a new arrival tracked to a Fenumion settlement.

Enough time for one another

Fenwick entered wanting to be useful and hoping he would not have to work alone. Farkur entered afraid of his own rustiness. By the end, Farkur has held to the crystal through heat and obscured sight while Fenwick and the others have repeatedly turned their attention from attacking to keeping companions alive.

The collapse follows the crystal’s destruction, giving this expedition a definite success. Its less visible achievement is in the moments before that: a fallen Espera restored, healing sent to Ryvyt while Fenwick is barely standing, and Djöhandrai’s alarm giving way to relief when he sees help arrive.

They leave with unfinished conversations and an invitation to a shop. After the lava, rocks and repeated falls, those ordinary plans are the future the company has managed to preserve.
